title: Aegis Run Record v1
description: Record of one Aegis-assisted application run. verify can check record structure and copied artifact hashes offline; the record does not prove host or model identity, app correctness, security, delivery or universal support.

run_id.description: UUID4 generated at init; identifies this run attempt.

app.description: Application name supplied by the operator.

aegis_commit.description: Exact Aegis commit asserted for the run; not validated.

model.description: Model used by the builder; a non-empty string when supplied, null only when not supplied. Required key, unverified value.

created_at.description: UTC initialization time from the local clock.

owner.description: Accountable owner; optional key, null when not supplied.

events.description: Events in append order; mirrors events.jsonl exactly.

artifacts.description: Artifacts: copied entries plus any external references.

outcome.description: Run outcome; null only before finish. export and verify require a non-null value.

limitations.description: Stated scope limits; empty only before finish. finish and export require at least one, and verify rejects an exported record with none.

ts.description: UTC append time from the local clock.

path.description: Copied artifact path relative to the run directory, with / separators; null only when external is true. Never absolute.

source.description: Original file reference, relative to the run directory and slash-normalized; may begin with ../. Never absolute.

bytes.description: Exact file size at recording time.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact file bytes.

portable.description: True only for a copied artifact with a relative path.

external.description: True for a reference that was hashed but not copied; verify treats it as EXTERNAL/UNVERIFIED.

kind.description: Operator label from the fixed v1 kind set; null when not supplied.
